title: DocumentationFrontMatter
description: Schema for validating YAML front matter across aimdl-documentation markdown pages.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the document.

owner_team.description: Team identifier responsible for maintaining the page.

primary_contact.description: GitHub username or contact name responsible for the page.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last completed review, or null if unreviewed.

review_cycle.description: Review period threshold, such as '6 months' or '12 months'.

safety_level.description: Classification of the page's procedural and safety risk.
